title: Grilled Chicken Rice Bowl (Mediterranean Style)
blurb: The marinade and the dressing share half their ingredients, so a lemon and a head of garlic really only get measured out once between the two.

ingredients.note: for the marinade, the rice and the dressing
for the marinade and the dressing

steps: Marinate the chicken: mix 2 tablespoons of the olive oil, two-thirds of the lemon juice, three-quarters of the garlic, the paprika, oregano, cumin, salt and pepper in a bowl. Coat the chicken well and marinate at least 20 to 30 minutes, or overnight for deeper flavor.
Cook the rice: rinse the rice and cook it with the water, 1 tablespoon of the olive oil and salt. Once done, fluff with a fork and set aside.
Grill the chicken: heat a grill pan or skillet over medium heat. Cook the chicken about 5 to 6 minutes per side, until fully cooked and slightly charred. Let it rest, then slice.
Prepare the dressing: whisk together the remaining olive oil, lemon juice and garlic with the Dijon mustard, honey, salt and pepper until smooth.
Assemble the bowl: start with a base of rice, then add the sliced chicken, tomatoes, cucumber, red onion, olives and feta cheese.
Drizzle with the dressing and sprinkle fresh herbs on top. Serve immediately.
